Happy Independence Day! Sewing Pattern Review: New Look

I used New Look 6184 for the dress top (view C) and sash (view E). I used New Look 6447 for the dress skirt (view C).

Measurements: 33" bust, 26" waist, 33" hips. I used size 10 for the top and sash and size 8 for the skirt. The top is ample, and I would use the size 8 pattern piece if I made this again. The dress is comfortable and not tight at all anywhere. The skirt on pattern 6184 needed a lot more fabric than I had on hand, so that is why I chose to use the skirt on pattern 6447. I fully lined the top and the skirt.

If I were to make the sash again, I would make one tie end longer than the other tie end. I like to off-set my bows or knots, and there really is no room to do that in the sash the way it's made per the pattern instructions. It does look cute tied in a bow in the front, but my preference is a side bow.
